Name: Oku's Mini Fridge - AT
Author: okubunny
Description:
Working as of October 2024 - Please leave a comment if you are experiencing a bug

It annoyed me that the mini fridge isn't an [i]actual[/i] mini fridge. So I made one!

How to get it working:

- Have smapi installed
- Download Alternative textures
- buy the paint bucket and mini fridge from robin if you don't have it (you will need the kitchen house upgrade to see the mini fridge)
- use the paint bucket on the fridge and you can choose my texture 

More colors are coming soon. Let me know what colors you want to see!

This is my first mod so let me know if there's any issues.
